content.text:
All three sizes are rendered and verified.

**Files in the working folder:** `square.png` (1080×1080), `landscape.png` (1920×1080), `story.png` (1080×1920), plus the source `card.html`.

**Design:** one HTML file whose layout switches on viewport aspect-ratio, so all three sizes share a single source of truth. Dark `#0F1226` canvas with violet glow bloom, Inter loaded via `@font-face` from the local variable TTF (verified `document.fonts.check` → true).

- **Square (master):** header logo + divider + event name; portrait circle with name/role beside it; 62px title in 3 lines; rule-separated footer with date/venue left and the pill CTA right.
- **Landscape:** two columns — title + footer on the left, large 400px portrait with name/role stacked beneath it on the right, vertically centered.
- **Story:** fully centered vertical stack with a larger portrait, 78px title in 4 lines, and the CTA below the date/venue.

**Verification** (automated box check in all three viewports): zero elements overflowing the viewport, zero overlapping text/element pairs, document scroll size exactly equal to the viewport (no clipping), and the avatar is exactly square in every size (170×170, 400×400, 360×360) so it stays a true circle. The title wraps to 3–4 lines everywhere with no truncation. I also used non-breaking hyphens in "Okonkwo‑Lindqvist" and "on‑call" so they never break awkwardly across lines.
